title: Our amazing body organs
summary: Review what your main body organs do and how to care for them.
keyIdeas: The brain, heart, lungs and stomach are important body organs.
Each organ has a special job that helps keep us alive and healthy.
Exercise and eating well help us care for our organs.

basicKnowledge: A. Cultura científica › La vida en nuestro planeta
A. Cultura científica › Iniciación en la actividad científica

activities.prompt: Omar puts his hand on his chest and feels fast beats. Which organ pumps blood?
activities.explanation: The heart is a muscle that pumps blood around the body.
activities.hint: It goes thump-thump inside your chest.

activities.prompt: The brain controls our thoughts and feelings.
activities.explanation: The brain controls thoughts, memories, emotions and body movements.

activities.prompt: Match each organ to its main job.
activities.explanation: Each organ has an important job in our body.
Air reaches the lungs. There, oxygen passes from the air into the blood.
activities.sentence: When we breathe in through our nose, air reaches the ___.

activities.prompt: Sort these organs by where they are in the body.
activities.explanation: The brain is protected inside the head. The heart, lungs and stomach are in the trunk, the main part of the body.

activities.prompt: Aisha skips at break time. Her heart beats faster. Why?
activities.explanation: During exercise, muscles work harder and need the heart to pump blood faster.
activities.hint: Think about what your legs need when you run.
options: Her heart is tired and wants to stop
Her working muscles need more blood and oxygen
Her lungs have stopped working while she jumps

activities.prompt: Find the statement about organs that contains a mistake.
activities.explanation: The heart keeps beating while we sleep. The lungs let air move in and out as we breathe.
activities.hint: One organ keeps working day and night.
options: The heart stops when we sleep
The lungs let us breathe air in and out

activities.prompt: Put a strawberry's journey through the body in order.
activities.explanation: Digestion starts in the mouth. Food passes through the oesophagus and stomach, then reaches the intestines.
items: It enters the mouth and our teeth chew it
It reaches the stomach to be mixed and digested
It passes into the intestines, where nutrients are absorbed

activities.prompt: Martina rides a bike in the park. What helps protect her brain if she falls?
activities.explanation: The skull protects the brain inside the head. A helmet adds protection outside if we fall.

activities.prompt: Read the story carefully and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: The heart moves blood. In the lungs, blood receives oxygen from the air. They work together.
activities.title: Hugo's visit to the doctor
activities.text: Hugo visits Doctor Laura at the health centre. She uses a tool to listen to his chest. His heart beats strongly and steadily. Then she asks him to breathe deeply. Laura listens to air moving in and out of his lungs. Hugo's organs work as a team!

questions.prompt: Which organs does the doctor listen to when Hugo breathes deeply?
questions.explanation: When Hugo breathes deeply, air enters his lungs and the doctor hears his breathing.

questions.prompt: Why is it important for organs to work together?
questions.explanation: Organs help each other so our body works well.
options: So we can sleep all day
So we never need to eat again
To keep our body alive and healthy
